title: FLIR1 object may be a balloon

tellings.quote: That of course suggests that what we're looking at is actually a balloon.

related.note: This explains the same FLIR1 object as a balloon, while the existing story calls it a distant aircraft. These are competing core claims about one object.

plain: The object in FLIR1, a 2004 Navy video taken with a forward-looking infrared camera off Southern California, may simply be a balloon, according to the UFO skeptic Mick West. He makes the case from his own analysis of the footage, saying what it shows "of course suggests that what we're looking at is actually a balloon," while others link the same clip to a white oval object shaped like a Tic Tac mint. If he is right, one of the best-known military UFO videos would have an ordinary explanation.
